name: 3nin-me no Raison D'être -After the End-
original_name: 3人目のレーゾンデートル -After the end-
source:
The sequel of [url=/v21607]3nin-me no Raison D'être[/url], set after particular endings:

1: bad end after
Set post-Bad ED, this story focuses on end-of-year celebrations after Rosalia and Werner happily become husband and wife.

2: normal end after
Set after the Normal ED... well, more like during the events leading up to the epilogue. A story about a pet owner and her dog's end-of-year celebrations.

Note: The creator recommends that players at least complete the Bad and Normal endings of the original game prior to playing this one.

[Translation of the official website's plot summary.]
translation:
[url=/v21607]3nin-me no Raison D'être[/url] 的续集，以特定结局为背景：

1：之后的糟糕结局
这个故事以《Bad ED》为背景，重点讲述罗莎莉亚和沃纳幸福地成为夫妻后的年终庆祝活动。

2：正常结束后
设定在普通ED之后……嗯，更像是在尾声之前的事件期间。一个关于宠物主人和她的狗的年终庆祝活动的故事。

注意：创作者建议玩家在玩本游戏之前至少完成原版游戏的“Bad”和“Normal”结局。

【官网剧情概要翻译。】
